title: Yield and protein of four heritage wheats
bodyMd: Agronomist Pekka Hyvönen grew four heritage varieties of wheat side by side on the same farm for one season and measured each variety's grain yield and the protein content of its grain.

data.caption: Grain yield and grain protein content of four heritage wheat varieties grown on the same farm in one season (Hyvönen).

accessibilityText: A four-row table of wheat results. Columns are variety, grain yield in tonnes per hectare, and protein content of the grain as a percent. Rødkorn: 3.1 tonnes per hectare, 14.2 percent protein. Hallstatt Red: 4.0 tonnes, 11.8 percent. Einmark: 2.6 tonnes, 15.1 percent. Lysvik: 3.7 tonnes, 12.9 percent.

provenance.notes: Original data set written for this item bank. The agronomist and all figures are invented, and the variety names are invented labels rather than real cultivars.
